routes.title: The Final Battle vs the Great Sea Monster

rows.en: At 1020 today, we received a message from the Earth Federation Army's Far East Command.
Operation Moonraker, conducted on the lunar surface, was a success...
rows.notes: Source trails off between report rows; ellipsis retained.

rows.en: The Earth Federation Army has reportedly captured the Giganos military's joint headquarters base.
...I see.
rows.notes: Ignore stray source closing bracket and trailing indent.

rows.en: The remaining Giganos forces have abandoned the Moon and fled to a debris zone in an enormous mobile fortress...
rows.notes: Report trails off; debris zone is descriptive, not a researched proper place name.

rows.en: The Earth Federation Army will continue pursuing them.
Heh... The Moon should be a little quieter now.
But the Gulfer's Spiral Castle is still there...
The situation in the Earth sphere remains unpredictable.
However, our enemy remains the Mu...
Now that an end to the war with Giganos is in sight... I would like to see greater cooperation with us at TERRA.
Commander, #部隊名's Nahel Argama has entered the Nirai Kanai area.
Understood. Have the Science Division examine the RahXephon.
Yes, sir.
...Of course, we already know there is nothing wrong with it.
That incident happened because of the location.

rows.notes: Silence retained.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Lure Dragonsaurus to the target point
1. Reduce Dragonsaurus's HP to 90% or less@2. Mazinger Z, Great Mazinger, Grendizer,@Getter Dragon shot down 3. Our mothership shot down
rows.notes: Nominal failure-condition list. Initial third line measured357px; compress Allied to Our, preserving friendly allegiance and all four named units, shot-down predicates and exact three source lines.

rows.en: Heave-ho, hey-ho~! Yo-ho-ho, and away we go~!
rows.notes: Rhythmic nonlexical singing adapted to English work-song syllables; unsupported musical-note glyph represented by singsong tildes.

rows.en: Boss, have you caught anything?
You can see for yourself. How about you?
No luck at all~.
Even the fish won't give us the time of day.
You said it. Sayaka, Jun, Hikaru, Maria, Michiru...
rows.notes: Name list intentionally continues across rows23-25; source fragment retained.

rows.en: Linda, Rose, Megumi, Mari, Rain, and then Asuka and Rei...
rows.notes: Continuation of name list from row23; source fragment retained.

rows.en: Miku, Haruka, Misato, #女愛称... Every last one turned me down.
rows.notes: Boss is rejected by every person named in rows23-25; subject restored in English.

rows.en: Maybe inviting them on a cruise in Borot was a bad idea after all.
Yeah, it kinda looks like it's gonna sink~.
Don't be stupid! I put a brand-new propeller on it!
You're right! When did you get that new one?!
Heh heh! I figured we might need it, so I swiped some Super Alloy Z and made one.
Swiped it...? You didn't take the stuff aboard the Nahel Argama, did you?
rows.notes: Question restores speaker and addressee; swiped material refers to Super Alloy Z.

rows.en: Don't make me sound like a crook! I just borrowed a little when I visited the Photon Power Laboratory the other day.
rows.notes: Borrowed is Boss jokingly euphemizing theft; denial and laboratory/time details retained.

rows.en: Isn't that what you call swiping it?
...Operation Moonraker may have succeeded, but these civilians certainly are carefree...
They are helping us out of goodwill. They are not employees we pay a salary to.
So we should overlook behavior like that? ...Commander, you seem incapable of grasping our current situation.
Heh... That's rather harsh.
Constantly being on alert wears people out, after all...
I think we ought to allow them some freedom while we're on Level 3 standby.
rows.notes: Level3 standby follows existing Level1/2 convention, not a battle-stations claim.

rows.en: Certainly, that is sound reasoning from a human rights standpoint.
Then how should we treat those who aren't Earthlings... no, aren't even human...? I'd like your opinion, Major.
rows.notes: Earthling corrected to human preserves Isshiki deliberate dehumanizing escalation. Major addresses Soichi.

rows.en: ...What do you mean?
Stop playing dumb. Do you think I haven't obtained information on the members of #部隊名?

rows.notes: Source wordless shocked reaction retained.

rows.en: Kim, give me a status report.
An incoming message from Great Mazinger, patrolling the nearby waters!
An enormous unidentified object is rapidly approaching Nirai Kanai!
Isn't it a Dolem?
Correct. We're not detecting any D1 Aria.
rows.notes: Affirmative confirms negative question: English Correct avoids ambiguous Yes. D1 identifier preserved with existing Aria spelling.
uncertain: Exact D1 Aria compound lacks a glossary entry; D1 retained as source identifier, Aria follows campaign term.

rows.en: ...If it's heading here, it can't be an Angel, either.
Kim, have we learned anything else about the unidentified object?
According to the report, it looks like a living creature... and is moving through the water at high speed.
Then it may be a biological weapon belonging to the Hyakki Empire... or the Vegan Empire forces.
Declare DEFCON 2 across the island. Activate the interception systems. Evacuate the coastal residents immediately.
Roger!
Our first real battle in quite some time... Let's see what you can do, Commander Kunugi.
rows.notes: Internal thought mocking Kunugi; first real battle in some time refers to base personnel.

rows.en: Boss, the siren's going off.
Huh? Is it lunchtime already?
What are you talking about?! That's an alarm! An alarm!!
The target is making a sharp course change! It has breached the third warning line!
Stop it with interception system six!
rows.notes: Command to Kim/system personnel; imperative retains grammatical subject omission as an order.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
Whoa! W-what the hell is going on?!
It's no good! We're having no effect!
That's impossible! Every shot hit it, didn't it?!
B-but the target isn't slowing down! It's entering the bay!
Declare DEFCON 1. Request that #部隊名 scramble.
R-roger!
B-Boss! This is bad!!
Mucha, Nuke! We're heading back to the Nahel Argama!!
The target is surfacing!!
B-B-B-Boss! L-l-l-look at that!!
rows.notes: Repeated stutters retained before Boss and look.

rows.en: A-a monster?!
rows.notes: Deliberate startled noun fragment retained.

rows.en: I-it's coming this way!!
We're getting out of here! Hang on tight!!
I-it's chasing us!!
D-don't tell me it's just like Gilgilgan?!
rows.notes: Mucha connects metal-eating Gilgilgan with creature pursuit; English preserves question without adding explicit metal explanation.

rows.en: Damn it, Borot doesn't even taste good!!
That damn monster's entered the bay! ...Hm?! What's that?!
T-Tetsuya!!

rows.en: Dr. Saotome and the others...?

rows.en: Yes. The people considered Japan's greatest minds are coming together to deal with this crisis.

rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: ...Damn it, I can't believe Boss Borot was taken down...!
rows.notes: Koji laments apparent destruction, not confirmed death.

rows.en: Koji...
rows.notes: Sayaka addresses distressed Koji; intentional name-only fragment.

rows.en: After that, they surely can't be alive...
rows.notes: They refers to Boss, Mucha and Nuke swallowed with Borot, settled by rows70-89 and117.

rows.en: Next...? The Federation took over Giganos' lunar base, right? There's still more to do?

rows.en: Could the Gulfer or the Martian Successors have made a new move...?
rows.notes: Masato speculates about enemy movements; source trails off with question, kept ellipsis.

rows.en: ...I'll explain the details later. For now, we have to handle this problem ourselves.

rows.en: Then that's all the more reason to let us launch right now!

rows.en: Koji, have you forgotten what Major Yakumo said? Conventional weapons barely work on that monster.

rows.en: That's right. The bastard swallowed not just TERRA's interceptor missiles, but even Great's Navel Missile.
rows.notes: Not just...but even retains escalating contrast. Great is source-short Great Mazinger. Bastard carries derogatory phrasing.

rows.en: Then why didn't you use the Great Booster!? You could've killed it with that!
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: How could I use my trump card right away against an enemy I knew nothing about? Especially in a place like that.
rows.notes: Tetsuya defends withholding trump card; place is bay near Nirai Kanai, explained137-138. No invented collateral detail.

rows.en: ...Yes. As it turned out, Tetsuya made the right call.
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: What...?!
rows.notes: Alternate route: reacts to vaccine failure and required physical destruction.

rows.en: According to Dr. Saotome's report, that monster's body seems to be full of heavy fuel oil.
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: If Tetsuya had finished it off there... the damage to Nirai Kanai would've been far worse.
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: But that thing swallowed Boss, remember!?
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: Well, he's tougher than he looks... Maybe you don't need to worry so much?
rows.notes: He is Boss, from139. Light reassures Koji rather than promises confirmed survival.

rows.en: How can you be so carefree!?
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: Light has a point. Whatever's happened, those guys have always managed to survive so far.
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: They may be even better at staying alive than Warrant Officer Oceano and his friends.
rows.notes: Oceano is Tapp and friends are Dragonar team. Rank explicitly preserved. Comparison is speculative. Semantic review: staying alive makes survival comparison explicit rather than suggesting literal attacks against the Dragonar team.

rows.en: Besides, Koji... don't you know that better than anyone?
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: W-well, that's true, but...
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: ...Whatever the case, we can say your slow response caused this incident.
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: Inspector, that's not true!
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: What's not true? If Tetsuya Tsurugi had taken proper action when the target was first sighted, it would've ended right there.
rows.notes: Isshiki blames Tetsuya by full name, as source; no assertion narrator endorses it.

rows.en: What did you say...!?
rows.notes: Tetsuya angrily challenges Ryoma's accusation; explicit spoken reaction.

rows.en: You misjudged when to use your trump card, and you drew that monster to Nirai Kanai... That is a grave offense.
rows.notes: Isshiki weaponizes trump-card timing and monster arrival as accusation, preserving gravity.
Tetsuya's silent shocked reaction; punctuation-only omission retained.

rows.en: How can you say that while ignoring how badly you handled things yourselves?
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: TERRA is a strategic organization for fighting the MU. It was not created to fight monsters like that.
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: So you're telling us to take care of that thing ourselves? Ha! Bring it on!
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: Hmph... You'd better take care that it doesn't swallow you too.
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: Huh? Isn't swallowing things Mr. White Snake's specialty?
rows.notes: White Snake is Kaine mocking Isshiki, confirmed155-157. Swallowing pun kept literal, no added insinuation.

rows.en: ...Who are you calling a white snake?
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: Gee, who could I mean~?
rows.notes: Kaine sarcastically feigns ignorance; source tilde retained.

rows.en: That's enough, Wakaba. ...Major Yakumo, our unit is to deal with that monster, correct?
rows.notes: Context: Briefing and heated discussion of monster response. Speaker and addressee follow the surrounding scene; full meaning drafted before measurement.

rows.en: Yes. The Federation has made the same request. I'm truly sorry to trouble you, but... we're counting on you.
rows.notes: Soichi asks Bright and squad to help; counting on you preserves request direction, not offer.

rows.en: Then, Major Katsuragi... contact Dr. Saotome. After that, we'll head to the Sumonada Sea and join the special task force.
rows.notes: Bright orders Misato to contact Saotome, then whole unit travels to join task force. Major Katsuragi reflects source rank. Geography term verified by orchestrator; official Nagasaki City and official city tourism use Sumonada Sea, no Akurasu entry.

rows.en: Understood.
...Good grief. That was quite an unexpected visitor.
If we extrapolate from the data gathered so far...
rows.notes: Intentional source fragment; row163 completes the data-based inference.

rows.en: I believe it is most likely a surviving ancient organism, rather than something from beyond Earth.
Hmm... It seems Earth's natural world still holds plenty of mysteries and secrets.
It seems unlikely, but could that thing be...
rows.notes: Intentional speculation trails off; row166 stops Kunugi from naming it. Unnamed connection not supplied.

rows.en: ...You shouldn't say things like that so casually. Walls have ears, and screens have eyes...
rows.notes: Preserved source surveillance proverb, including both ears and eyes.

rows.en: Then you're saying it has nothing to do with the current affair?
rows.notes: Current affair left unspecified as in source; no invented TERRA secret.

rows.en: Yes. We should consider it a natural disaster... No, divine punishment.
rows.notes: Retained correction from natural disaster to divine punishment.

rows.en: ...Then we're relying on the Federation Forces and #部隊名 again?
Yes. It pains me that TERRA cannot openly offer them extensive assistance, but...
rows.notes: Intentional trailing contrast; row171 supplies Watari personal contribution.

rows.en: I've already done what I could from my position.
Could you be the one who called on the doctors at each facility to form the special task force...?
rows.notes: Question trails off before naming Watari; the addressee is clear.

rows.en: Well, never mind that...
rows.notes: Deliberate topic diversion fragment.

rows.en: Would you like some Getter manju I brought back from Mount Asama...? They're wonderfully stretchy.
rows.notes: Source souvenir food name; stretchy texture retained without guessing ingredients. Orchestrator confirms source-fictional compound; generic manju corroborated by JNTO, no licensed phrase claimed.

rows.en: ...That concludes the footage of the giant creature that attacked Japan's Kyushu region.
Hmm... To think a monster like that has survived since ancient times.
Emperor Burai, I propose we capture that monster and use it to bolster our forces.
rows.notes: Burai address retains emperor title.

rows.en: Hmph. A pointless endeavor.
What do you mean, Chief Zuril? Guest from the Vegan Empire or not, I will not tolerate your insolence!
rows.notes: Zuril source rank translated Minister; Vegan Empire glossary organization. Root final-only ranked-address correction: Chief Zuril follows source-short rank and central alias.

rows.en: Then tell me, General Hidler. How do you intend to capture a monster impervious to conventional weapons?
rows.notes: General Hidler binding glossary takes precedence over literal marshal.

rows.en: Urgh...
rows.notes: Hesitant reaction fragment.

rows.en: Besides, it appears those Earthlings are having trouble with it, too...
Would it not be better to exploit that monster, rather than capture it?
rows.notes: Exploit means use indirectly, as strategy in186–187 clarifies; not capture.

rows.en: Exploit it?
Chief Zuril, let us hear your plan.
rows.notes: Root final-only ranked-address correction: Chief Zuril follows source-short rank and central alias.

rows.en: Yes, sir. Those Earthlings will probably send #部隊名 against the monster...
rows.notes: Expectation trails off deliberately; Earthlings are deploying the named squad.

rows.en: Then, once fighting it has worn them down, our forces will crush them in a single strike.
I see. An excellent plan. Even they cannot expect to fight such a monster and emerge unscathed.
Very well. I shall entrust the next operation to Zuril. However...
rows.notes: Deliberate condition left hanging for Zuril to finish in190.

rows.en: You mean I am to provide my own troops?
Correct. Your true intention may well be to wear down our forces.
Perish the thought. I shall prove myself by defeating #部隊名 in the next operation.
This fellow... The brazen nerve of him...!
rows.notes: Dr. Gura reacts to Zuril blatant denial in192. Source indignation fragment retained without asserting literal lies.

rows.en: Hidler, I shall give you troops as well. Work with Zuril to finish off those Getter Robos.
Hyakki, Buraaai!
rows.notes: Repeated salute in three original uses; retain elongated cry.
uncertain: Exact established English catchcry spelling unconfirmed.

rows.en: ...Everyone seems to be here. I will now explain the outline of our operation against Dragonsaurus.
Dragonsaurus? Is that the monster's name?
That's right, Nagare.
rows.notes: Nagare surname explicitly in source; not expanded to Ryoma.

rows.en: Then, Dad... You're saying it's a creature from Earth, rather than some space monster?
Yes. We believe it is a species of ancient organism that has been lurking in the deep sea.
I see. So that thing was a UMA.
rows.notes: UMA retained for source acronym/horse pun. No imported cryptid definition. UMA expansion corroborated by official Adachi City PDF supplemental entry.

rows.en: A horse? Don't you mean an octopus?
rows.notes: Source hears UMA as Japanese uma (horse); retains horse/octopus joke rather than substituting animals.
uncertain: UMA/uma horse pun does not transfer phonetically without knowledge of Japanese. Original joke retained and row202 pronunciation cue supplied.

rows.en: No, I said... UMA. "Yoo-ma."
rows.notes: Pronunciation cue added to carry the Japanese acronym mishearing in English.

rows.en: What's that?
UMA stands for Unidentified Mysterious Animal...
rows.notes: Source acronym expansion reproduced literally; deliberate trailing explanatory fragment. Source expansion corroborated by official Adachi City PDF; not a licensed game-translation quotation.

rows.en: It means an unconfirmed creature whose existence has not yet been fully explained.
rows.notes: Existence remains unconfirmed; no claim creature is merely undiscovered species.

rows.en: So it's like Nessie or Hibagon, then?
rows.notes: Source cryptid names preserved. Nessie corroborated by official VisitScotland; Hibagon by official Hiroshima Prefecture supplemental entries.

rows.en: H-Hibagon...? You sure know some obscure ones.
rows.notes: H-Hibagon stutter retained; obscure-name reaction preserved. Name corroborated by Hiroshima Prefecture supplemental entry.

rows.en: But for a creature in the same category as a Yeti, does it not possess power far beyond common sense?
rows.notes: Rhetorical question: Dragonsaurus power exceeds category expectations. Yeti spelling corroborated by Smithsonian catalogue supplemental entry.

rows.en: True. Most UMAs seem pretty phony, but... A creature that shrugs off missiles? That's another story.
More than that... According to reports, Dragonsaurus quickly regenerated a neck severed in battle with the Federation Forces.
rows.notes: Neck (kubi) regenerated; head not substituted because source explicitly describes severed neck.
uncertain: Source kubi may denote neck or head. Neck retained as literal anatomical reading for this multi-necked sea monster; no licensed English wording claimed.

rows.en: Ha! That's on par with the Devil Gundam.
Isn't it closer to a Dolem or an Angel than to a living creature?
It's only natural for you to think so.
We believe that Dragonsaurus probably underwent a mutation for some reason.
rows.notes: Mutation remains a probabilistic explanation, cause unspecified.

rows.en: Then... Some force acted on it, giving it that appearance and those abilities?
Yes...
And we humans may well have been responsible for causing it.
Director, what do you mean?
It most likely took that form because of heavy oil, industrial waste, and even radiation flowing into the sea.
rows.notes: All three pollution causes retained: heavy oil, industrial waste, radiation.

rows.en: W-what!? Dad, is that really true!?
Yes. It may be humanity, with its continued pollution of the sea, that created Dragonsaurus.

rows.notes: Nonverbal shocked reaction retained.

rows.en: ...If humans pollute nature, they will suffer the consequences. ...Just as my master once said.
rows.notes: Master referent is Domon own master; no imported name.
Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: So, Misato... What are we supposed to do?
To put it plainly, we're to annihilate Dragonsaurus.
The Federation fleet is currently luring it toward a small island in the Sumonada Sea.
rows.notes: Sumonada Sea spelling confirmed by orchestrator via official Nagasaki tourism.

rows.en: Luring it? How?
Our research has shown that Dragonsaurus responds to a particular kind of sound wave.
So we built a device that produces those waves and installed it on a Federation speedboat to lure the monster.
What happens after we lure it there?
We'll deploy a highly elastic wire net on the target island's shore and capture Dragonsaurus...
rows.notes: Intentional trailing capture setup continued in232.

rows.en: Once it cannot move, we'll all launch an attack at once.
In other words, a carp on the chopping board... A kappa dragged ashore.
rows.notes: Both source comparisons retained: carp on chopping board, kappa on land. Kappa spelling corroborated by official JNTO supplemental entry.

rows.en: Right. Dragonsaurus is a marine creature, so bringing it onto land should slow it down.
But its body is full of heavy oil, isn't it? If we attack it carelessly, something terrible could...
rows.notes: Intentional consequence fragment; sentence trails off in source.

rows.en: Previous battles have proved it won't trigger an explosion as long as we don't deal damage at or above a certain level all at once.
rows.notes: Threshold includes equality (at or above); applies to damage all at once, not cumulative damage.

rows.en: Besides, the island we're luring it to was abandoned during Second Impact... No one lives there now.
rows.notes: Island abandonment during Second Impact and current absence of inhabitants both retained.

rows.en: ...I see...
And, Major Katsuragi... What about a way to rescue Borot?
rows.notes: Borot is source-short Boss Borot. Major Katsuragi is explicit rank/name address.

rows.en: Once the wires hold the target in place, we'll send a special rescue team inside its body.
rows.notes: Misato answers Daisuke about the rescue method; target/body are Dragonsaurus.

rows.en: That's far too dangerous! It would be one thing to send our machines in, but sending unprotected people inside that thing's body...!
rows.notes: Daisuke objects to sending people in without machines; trailing incredulous construction preserved. Final restores the send action in the machines comparison for natural spoken clarity; not a fit edit.

rows.en: Using your machines would be even more dangerous. A single spark could be fatal, you know?
Then who are you going to send inside Dragonsaurus...?
That would be...
rows.notes: Misato deliberately leaves the rescuer unnamed; Miku completes the identification at245.

rows.en: I'm the one.
rows.notes: Miku identifies herself as the designated rescuer, answering Misato244; final replaces volunteer-sounding draft wording.

rows.en: What...!?
Miku, why does it have to be you!?
rows.notes: Female lead asks why Miku is the selected rescuer, not why Miku volunteered.

rows.en: ...Because I'm the best person for this mission...
rows.notes: Restored Miku as explicit subject; answer to247.

rows.en: What do you mean, the best person?
Y-yeah! It'd be one thing for Gundam Fighters like us, but sending Miku in...!
rows.notes: Allenby contrasts physically capable Gundam Fighters with Miku; disbelief intentionally trails off.

rows.en: I'll be all right. I've had special training for situations just like this...
Miku...
rows.notes: Name-only worried thought; deliberate source fragment.

rows.en: ...That's the outline. Everyone, take Level 2 battle stations. We'll begin the operation as soon as the target moves.
rows.notes: Misato addresses all personnel; Level 2 convention preserved.

rows.en: Well then, let's kick off one hell of a fishing trip and reel in Dragonsaurus!
rows.notes: Single-hook fishing metaphor carried as reeling in the monster; exuberant slang preserves tone.

rows.en: I wonder if this is really gonna work.
It'll be fine. After all, our fishing line is the unbreakable bond between us.
rows.notes: Light extends the fishing metaphor to the squad bond; not a literal cable claim.

rows.en: Hey, you... You thought that was a pretty good line, didn't you?
Don't spoil the moment with cracks like that.
rows.notes: Light rebukes Tapp for puncturing his sentimental line; idiomatic rendering of the unrefined aside.

rows.en: ...Tetsuya, Koji. Go up to the bridge. Captain Bright says he wants to talk to you.
Huh?
To us...?
rows.notes: Deliberate echo fragment asking whether the summons concerns them.

rows.en: Captain, we'll be entering the operation area shortly.
Understood. What's the status of the wire net on the island?
According to Dr. Saotome's report, it's already been installed.
How is the Earth Federation fleet doing?
rows.notes: Supplied status question verb. Federation naval fleet contextualizes military organization term.

rows.en: They began luring the target a little while ago. So far, everything is going according to plan.
rows.notes: They is the Earth Federation fleet from265, not the rescue team.

rows.en: So, for now, the first phase of the operation is a success...
rows.notes: Bright assesses the first phase provisionally, before monster capture.

rows.en: Captain Bright...
rows.notes: Tetsuya calls to Bright; deliberate address-only fragment.

rows.en: You're here, both of you.
What did you want to talk to us about?
Well... There's something I want to make absolutely clear to you two.
Make clear?
rows.notes: Echo fragment of Bright271 preserved.

rows.en: Yes. Coordinating our actions will be crucial to this operation...
If anyone is nursing a grudge at a time like this, it could seriously affect the entire operation.
rows.notes: Grudge refers to Koji/Tetsuya dispute (source113-137), which Bright identifies at275-276.

rows.en: Do you mean... me and Tetsuya?
Yes.

rows.notes: Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: Huh? This code...
rows.notes: Rose starts an unfinished recognition of the communications code.

rows.en: What's wrong?
We're receiving an outside transmission using our squad's code.
Could it be from the Nadesico?
rows.notes: Nadesico preserves unspecified ship suffix in source.

rows.en: No, it's coming from somewhere pretty close by.
Put it through for now.
Y-yes...
Heeey, can you hear me!? Everybody in #部隊名!!
rows.notes: Runtime squad placeholder preserved exactly; Boss shouts over comms.

rows.en: B-Boss!?
What!?
I-it's definitely him! Captain, we're getting a transmission from Borot!
rows.notes: Him is Boss, positively identified by voice; Borot source-short unit form preserved.
Bright's wordless surprise retained.

rows.en: You're alive, Boss!!
You're damn right I am! You think yours truly would croak that easily!?
rows.notes: Boss boasts that he would not die easily; idiomatic emphatic opening preserves swagger.

rows.en: Boss! Where are you!?
Inside that monster's belly! So hurry up and come save me! Borot's broken down and won't move!
rows.notes: Me is Boss requesting rescue; Borot cannot move due to malfunction.

rows.en: Hang on, Boss! We'll get you out of there, I promise!
rows.notes: Tetsuya promises rescue by the team; restored we.

rows.en: Y-you mean that, Tetsuya!?
Of course I do! I don't say things just to make you feel better!
Then get over here, fast! I'm counting on you!!
rows.notes: Boss asks Tetsuya/the team for rescue; I am counting on you preserves request direction.

rows.en: Boss!? Boss, answer me!!
No good, the transmission's cut off...!
B-Boss...!
rows.notes: Koji calls Boss after transmission is lost; deliberate name-only fragment.

rows.en: But now we know for sure that they're alive.
rows.notes: They is Boss and his fellow Borot occupants, established in80-89 and continued at321.

rows.en: Yeah. We'll get you out of there, Boss. I swear it...!
...Tetsuya, I take back what I said earlier. ...I'm sorry.
rows.notes: Koji retracts his accusation that Tetsuya abandoned Boss (117-119); sorry is an apology to Tetsuya.

rows.en: What are you talking about? I haven't let it bother me.
More importantly, let's work together to save Boss and defeat Dragonsaurus.
rows.notes: Now becomes present urgent cooperation; both saving Boss and defeating Dragonsaurus retained.

rows.en: Yeah!
It looks like I didn't need to spell it all out after all.
rows.notes: Bright sees their reconciliation and need not finish his earlier admonition.

rows.en: All right... All hands, switch to Level 1 battle stations. All units, launch as soon as we reach the island.
Dr. Kabuto, we've finished the final check of the wire net's control system.
rows.notes: Dr. Kabuto is Kenzo, immediately replying308; title retained rather than identifying Koji.

rows.en: Thank you. Then I'll leave activating it to you, Genzo Umon.
rows.notes: Genzo Umon is frozen glossary form for source doctor address; leave activating it is delegation to Umon.

rows.en: Dr. Saotome, how is the special sonic generator fitted to Getter working?
rows.notes: Getter is source-short machine designation; special sonic generator translated descriptively.

rows.en: There are no problems. It should lure Dragonsaurus over here without any trouble.
rows.notes: It is the sonic generator; here is the island operation site.

rows.en: Now all we have to do is wait for that monster to arrive...
...Nahel Argama to all units. I'll go over the operation's steps one more time.
First, when Dragonsaurus enters these waters, Getter, fitted with the special sonic generator, will take the lead...
rows.notes: Misato begins the first operation step; trailing lead-in preserved before instruction314.

rows.en: Lure it onto the island's shore, where the wire net is set up.
rows.notes: Misato instructs Getter crew to lure Dragonsaurus onto the shoreline, not the crew itself.

rows.en: Understood. The wire net is over there, right?
Yes, that's right.
rows.notes: Speaker and referents settled from original neighbors; full spoken meaning retained without compression.

rows.en: Ryo, let me handle luring Dragonsaurus with my Poseidon.
rows.notes: Ryo is source nickname for Ryoma, independently sourced in campaign_terms; Poseidon is source-short Getter Poseidon.

rows.en: Yeah, all right.
Everyone else, keep the target in check so it doesn't go anywhere else.
rows.notes: Everyone else addresses other deployed units; prevent target moving elsewhere.

rows.en: But be very careful. If you attack it more than necessary, it'll blow up with Borot still inside.
rows.notes: It is Dragonsaurus, which excessive attacks detonate together with trapped Borot; threat strength retained.

rows.en: Understood.
Then, once the wire net is deployed, Miku, go inside the target... and rescue Boss and the others.
Yes.
After that, all units attack the target at once. Destroy it in one assault, without giving it time to regenerate. Understood?
OK, leave it to me!
Incoming message from the Federation fleet! They report that the target has entered the operational waters!
Ryoma, switch on the sonic generator!
Roger!
rows.notes: Both uses checked: acknowledgment of sonic generator activation and later lure order.

rows.en: The target is coming into view!
That's Dragonsaurus...!
Boss is inside that thing's stomach...!
rows.notes: Stomach referent is Dragonsaurus; Boss is explicitly restored as subject.

rows.en: Hang on, Boss, Nuke, Mucha! We'll get you out, I promise!!
All right, begin the operation!
Now you'll see what our super robot army can really do! You'd better be ready!!
rows.notes: Super robot army is a generic collective, not a named organization.

rows.en: You swallowed Boss and the others because I screwed up...!
rows.notes: Tetsuya explicitly owns the mistake; you is Dragonsaurus.

rows.en: I'll make things right, Dragonsaurus!!
rows.notes: Tetsuya vows to make amends for his own mistake by confronting Dragonsaurus; make things right preserves responsibility rather than implying revenge for an enemy wrong.

rows.en: I'm sorry, Dragonsaurus...! Humans may be the ones who made you this way, and yet...!
rows.notes: Source unfinished concession preserved: and yet...; humans remain a possible cause, not a certainty.

rows.en: But if you attack people, we can't just let you get away with it...!
So we'll take the full force of your anger!!
rows.notes: We is the Getter team; anger belongs to Dragonsaurus.

rows.en: Humanity's pollution of nature has brought about this disaster...!
But I swear! I'll never let a tragedy like this one with Dragonsaurus happen again!
rows.notes: I is Duke; never again pledge retains tragedy and Dragonsaurus.

rows.en: This won't go like last time, Duke Fleed!
Zuril! It looks like you're serious today!
We're out of time! We'll defeat you here and claim this Earth for our Vegan Empire!!
Playtime's over, Duke Fleed! Today, I'm taking your head!
Come on! No matter how powerful you are, as long as that power is evil, I won't lose!
rows.notes: Duke addresses evil enemy power; no referent gender assumed.

rows.en: You may plan to use Dragonsaurus to defeat us... but we won't let you, Hidler!
Fool! We use anything we can... That's how we do things!
Get ready, you monster bastard! Nobody beats us in a contest of brute force!!
rows.notes: Monster bastard preserves rough insult; force contest is physical strength.

rows.en: Forgive me, Dragonsaurus... Maybe all you really wanted was to live quietly at the bottom of the sea...
rows.notes: Speculative wish retained; no monster gender assigned.

rows.en: But as long as you bare your fangs at us, we have to face you in battle!
rows.notes: Fangs kept as hostile-attack metaphor; we is allied team.

rows.en: C-can an EVA really fight something this huge...?!
Idiot Shinji! It's just like an animal! If you get scared, it'll swallow your EVA too!
If humans really are the ones who created Dragonsaurus...
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional fragment spanning reflection with row354; source trails off.

rows.en: Is this world of ours... really... all right the way it is...?
rows.notes: Ayato questions the state of their world, not the morality of attacking alone.

rows.en: Here we go, Dragonsaurus! If you come at us, we won't back down!
Masato... That monster has swallowed so many ships and people...
rows.notes: Battle conversation reports swallowed ships and people; not an assertion of survivors.

rows.en: But that's because humans polluted the sea...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing explanation retained.

rows.en: That may well be true... But if Dragonsaurus keeps going like this...
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional fragment retained.

rows.en: I know! Right now, we have no choice but to stop that monster, whatever it takes!
What kind of body does it have, growing its heads back no matter how many times we cut them off?!
rows.notes: Regenerating heads, repeated severing, and anatomy question all retained.

rows.en: Crush a snake's head and it's finished! This one's real head seems to be in its belly!
rows.notes: Singular real head is the core in its belly; comparison is a snake.

rows.en: We'll aim there, #女愛称!
rows.notes: Speaker and addressed partner placeholders preserved exactly.

rows.en: Incoming message from the Federation fleet! They report that Hyakki Empire and Vegan Empire units are rapidly approaching these waters!
rows.notes: Federation is sender; both hostile factions are approaching.

rows.en: Damn, at a time like this! All units, prepare to intercept!
Tch, those bastards...! They sure picked the right time to show up!
rows.notes: Timing sarcasm refers to reinforcements while allies are occupied.

rows.en: They're not trying to capture Dragonsaurus alive, are they?!
Or do they plan to blow us up along with Dragonsaurus...?!
Damn it! Those bastards are acting like looters at a fire!
rows.notes: Fire-looter metaphor retained, meaning opportunistic attack during emergency.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... Just as I thought, you're having trouble with that monster.
All forces, begin the attack! Don't fall behind the Vegan Empire! We can't let them take the credit!
...Hmph, they sure talk as if they can do whatever they please.
rows.notes: Jigra sneers at Hidler and Hyakki forces claiming credit.

rows.en: Jigra, once we defeat Duke Fleed and the others, we can do whatever we like afterward. You know what I mean?
rows.notes: Afterward refers to after allied Duke group is defeated; veiled intent against Hyakki retained.

rows.en: Yeah. When the time comes, I'll have all the fun I want. I'll do what Earthlings call demon slaying.
rows.notes: Demon slaying alludes to turning on Hyakki allies; source calls this an Earth expression. Explicit I and do restore English subject and verb.
