rows.en: I'm sorry, Keisuke... But please try to understand her feelings... Orie's feelings...
rows.notes: Saionji asks Keisuke to understand Orie, his daughter. Source repeats the same referent with her / Orie; final removes draft too to prevent implying two women. Semantic fix, not compression.

rows.en: Vega is... Mom... Mom was... abducted by Altair...
rows.notes: Intentional source hesitation, name-only address or unfinished phrase retained.

rows.en: Hokuto...
rows.notes: Intentional source hesitation, name-only address or unfinished phrase retained.

rows.en: I'm sorry, Hokuto... We kept something so important a secret from you...
...Grandpa... Was it true...? What he... what Altair said...?
rows.notes: Hokuto asks whether Altair sister claim is true, supported by following confirmation.

rows.en: It is true that she is his sister...
rows.notes: She is Vega/Orie, his is Altair. Explicit English grammar settles both referents.

rows.en: Hokuto...
rows.notes: Intentional source hesitation, name-only address or unfinished phrase retained.

rows.en: M...Mom...
rows.notes: Hokuto brokenly calls for his kidnapped mother; intentional name fragment.

rows.en: ...Are you sure, Ginga? Now that it's come to this, we could explain everything to your parents ourselves, but...
rows.notes: Kirakuni offers to tell Ginga's parents; trailing but deliberately unfinished.

rows.en: If things get any more messed up, I really... I can't take it...
rows.notes: Ginga rejects more turmoil after revelations; colloquial mess, not invented family quarrel.

rows.en: Ginga...
rows.notes: Eris softly addresses Ginga; intentional name fragment.

rows.en: See you...
rows.notes: Ginga leaves; source farewell remains understated.

rows.en: Welcome home, Gin. Where've you been?
rows.notes: Midori greets son; Gin is campaign_terms contextual nickname.

rows.en: Uh... no... yeah...
rows.notes: Ginga hesitates without answering; intentional source hesitation.

rows.en: Well, never mind. It's been a while since you were home. Go play with Otome a little.
rows.notes: Midori asks him to play with sister; Otome is glossary name, no relationship added in body.

rows.en: Yeah...
rows.notes: Ginga acknowledges mother; intentional brief response.

rows.en: You haven't eaten yet, have you? Hang on... Mom's special stew is ready.
rows.notes: Midori has her own special stew ready; third-person Mom mirrors parental self-reference.

rows.en: What's wrong...?
rows.notes: Mother sees distress; restored full question.

rows.en: Uh... listen...
rows.notes: Ginga tentatively initiates topic; stray source closing delimiter ignored as brief directs.

rows.en: Yeah...?
rows.notes: Midori invites continuation; minimal questioning response.

rows.en: When you're in a fight... N-not that I got in a fight or anything...
rows.notes: Ginga evasively introduces fighting, denies actual fight; intentionally incomplete topical phrase.

rows.en: Yeah...
rows.notes: Midori prompts continuation; minimal acknowledgement.

rows.en: But... I mean... um... When you're in a fight...
rows.notes: Ginga struggles to state his topic; preserves hesitation and unfinished framing.

rows.en: I fight because I think I'm absolutely right... Um... does the other person fight thinking the same thing...?
rows.notes: Ginga asks if enemies feel equally right; restores both subject and verb, no asserted mutual correctness.

rows.en: Well... I suppose so... If it's a proper fight...
rows.notes: Mother gives qualified yes only for proper fight; deliberate conditional fragment.

rows.en: Then which side is right...?
rows.notes: Ginga asks which side is right; restored question verb.

rows.en: In a fight, both sides are right.
rows.notes: Mother states both sides right as subjective fight framing; literal claim preserved, no authorial correction.

rows.en: Just like you think you're not wrong...
rows.notes: First half of cross-row comparison; intentional continuation into581, stray delimiter ignored.

rows.en: the other person thinks they're not wrong either. Isn't that why you fight?
rows.notes: Completes580 then full question explaining opposing convictions.

rows.en: What matters is what it is you think you're right about.
rows.notes: Mother distinguishes motivation from conviction; full meaning and subject preserved.

rows.en: What do you fight for?
rows.notes: Mother asks reason for fighting; directed to Ginga.

rows.en: Never mind the fight. If you're wrong about that, there's no point. Do you understand, Ginga?
rows.notes: Mother says wrong motive makes fight pointless; source rhetorical force preserved.

rows.en: What I fight for... huh...
rows.notes: Ginga echoes question to himself; intentional contemplative fragment.

rows.en: Here, eat your stew. You can think about that from now on.
rows.notes: Mother shifts to food and tells him to think going forward, not a future-only postponement.

rows.en: ...Yeah...
rows.notes: Ginga subdued acknowledgement; source brevity retained.

rows.en: It seems Hokuto has taken quite a shock...
rows.notes: Aiko describes Hokuto emotional shock from identity revelation; no medical diagnosis added.

rows.en: Not just him. Ginga seems to have lost the will to fight, too.
rows.notes: Kirakuni extends loss of fighting spirit to Ginga.

rows.en: Well, you can't blame them. If someone calls you the worst villains of the century to your face, and even the Data Weapons abandon you...
rows.notes: Saburota explains understandable demoralization; conditional source thought trails unfinished after two causes.

rows.en: It may sound cruel, but we don't have time to wait for them to recover.
rows.notes: Quattro says no time to wait despite cruelty; them is both boys.

rows.en: Yes... Now that Ogre has all the Data Weapons, we need to act quickly.
rows.notes: Amuro calls urgent action because Ogre holds all Data Weapons; canonical Ogre shortened from unit name.

rows.en: ...Aiko... put that on the monitor.
rows.notes: Shibuya asks Aiko to show previously known item; that preserves unspecific source demonstrative.

rows.en: Yes...
rows.notes: Aiko acknowledges order.

rows.en: What's this...!?
rows.notes: Kirakuni reacts to displayed battleship; restored what-is question.

rows.en: It's a large battleship that suddenly appeared in lunar orbit two days ago.
rows.notes: Ruri reports large battleship and exact two-day lunar-orbit timing.

rows.en: Given the situation and its location, Altair most likely returned to this ship, rather than the Spiral Castle on the Moon.
rows.notes: Shibuya infers Altair return to ship, not lunar Spiral Castle; likelihood retained.

rows.en: So Deputy Commander Vega is there, too...
rows.notes: Amuro infers Vega presence at same ship; deputy commander rank retained, mother identity not redundantly added.

rows.en: If we know that, let's go rescue her right now!
rows.notes: Kirakuni urges immediate rescue; her is Vega, known female profile and context.

rows.en: Calm down, Kirakuni. A Federation fleet has already attacked that battleship, but...
rows.notes: Shibuya calms Kirakuni then reports prior attack; deliberate but continuation into601.

rows.en: Apparently, Machine Beast forces wiped them out in mere minutes.
rows.notes: Ruri reports fleet annihilation within minutes by Machine Beasts; reported uncertainty retained.

rows.en: So we'll have to be really prepared if we're going to take it on...
rows.notes: Saburota stresses resolve required to face ship, not generic tactical advice.

rows.en: Let's ask the Nahel Argama unit to help us.
rows.notes: Hari requests allied unit help; Nahel Argama canonical glossary spelling.

rows.en: They're all in the Far East right now too, aren't they?
rows.notes: Hari confirms unit Far East presence; restores full question.

rows.en: They're carrying out another operation. Interrupting it now would interfere with our future strategy.
rows.notes: Shibuya says interruption risks future strategy; their current separate operation explicit.

rows.en: Therefore, the Nadesico unit must carry out the assault on the enemy battleship alone.
rows.notes: Shibuya concludes Nadesico unit alone; stray source closing delimiter ignored.

rows.en: In the worst case, we'll have to fight without Dendoh...
rows.notes: Quattro qualifies absence of Dendoh as worst-case possibility; no asserted absence.

rows.en: If we launch a careless attack, we'll only get beaten back.
rows.notes: Quattro warns careless attack means enemy repulses them; no added annihilation.

rows.en: Indeed...
Chief Shibuya... I'll need to borrow your phone.
rows.notes: Ruri politely requests phone; no invented phone technology.

rows.en: What are you planning to do, Captain Hoshino?
rows.notes: Shibuya asks Ruri plan using surname+captain as source.

rows.en: I know someone who can help.
rows.notes: Ruri has a lead on help; someone natural rather than fixed identity unsupported by row.

rows.en: What...!?
rows.notes: Shibuya reacts with surprise.

rows.en: Can you really just phone for help like you're ordering takeout...?
rows.notes: Aiko likens phone request for reinforcements to ordering takeout; colloquial analogy preserved.

rows.en: Hello... Is this the secretarial office for the chairman of Nergal Heavy Industries?
rows.notes: Ruri phones chairman secretarial office; Nergal Heavy Industries canonical glossary.

rows.en: Hi... Ginga, Eris...
rows.notes: Keisuke greets Ginga and Eris; honorifics dropped.

rows.en: Good morning, sir...
rows.notes: Eris politely greets friend's father; sir natural address, not literal uncle kinship.

rows.en: How's Hokuto...?
rows.notes: Ginga asks about Hokuto condition, settled by618; grammatical question restored.

rows.en: He's been like that the whole time...
rows.notes: Keisuke says persistent condition; like that keeps visual state implicit.

rows.en: This is from my mom...
rows.notes: Ginga presents Midori stew; restored This is verb, source trailing gesture retained.

rows.en: Oh... stew... Let's have some right away, Hokuto.
rows.notes: Keisuke recognizes stew and invites son to eat immediately.

rows.en: Hokuto...
rows.notes: Eris addresses distressed Hokuto; deliberate name fragment.

rows.en: Thank you, Ginga.
rows.notes: Keisuke thanks Ginga for food.
Ginga hesitates; deliberate unfinished reply, no invented explanation.

rows.en: Come on, let's eat, Hokuto... You need to get something in your stomach...
rows.notes: Keisuke urges son to eat something; source trailing thought retained after full first clause.
Hokuto silence; intentional punctuation-only source line.

rows.en: U... ugh... uh...
rows.notes: Hokuto starts sobbing; source sounds rendered as vocal sounds, no narrator annotation.

rows.en: I want... to eat... Mom's stew...
rows.notes: Hokuto longs for Orie's stew, distinct from Midori stew offered; explicit I want restores source grammatical omission.
Silence shared by s0270:254 and i027a:34; fits both shame and withdrawal after the later mission discussion.

rows.en: Ugh... uh... ngh...
rows.notes: Continued sobbing as vocal sounds; no invented words.

rows.en: Let's save... your mom...!
rows.notes: Ginga proposes joint rescue of Hokuto mother; let's establishes both boys, not solo offer.

rows.en: Honestly, I still don't know what's what... But this is just plain wrong!
rows.notes: Ginga admits confusion but firmly judges abduction wrong; full intensity preserved.

rows.en: I don't know if she's his sister or whatever... I don't know if the Gulfer are right or whatever...
rows.notes: Ginga dismisses sister relationship and Gulfer justification as unresolved; ellipses kept without invented verdict.

rows.en: But Vega is your mom...!
rows.notes: Ginga asserts Vega is Hokuto mother as decisive fact.

rows.en: How can he drag her off like that and talk about peace in the universe...!? That bastard...!
rows.notes: Ginga condemns Altair kidnapping and claimed universal peace; bastard retains insult strength.

rows.en: Ginga...
rows.notes: Hokuto addresses friend; intentional name fragment.

rows.en: Come on, hurry up and eat! We're going! Crying here won't change anything!
rows.notes: Ginga urges eating then action; crying cannot change circumstances, not rebuke of grief itself.

rows.en: You won't even get to eat your mom's stew!
rows.notes: Your mom refers to Orie, from627; cannot enjoy stew while she remains captive, not Midori stew already present.

rows.en: Yeah...!
rows.notes: Agrees with Ginga.

rows.en: You're going to launch...!? No... but...
rows.notes: Shibuya reacts to boys' launch request; deliberative denial trails off.

rows.en: I'm going to save Mom...
rows.notes: Hokuto declares rescue of own mother; explicit I restores subject.

rows.en: Hokuto...
rows.notes: Shibuya calls Hokuto emotionally; intentional name fragment.

rows.en: And I want to hear her explain everything properly...
rows.notes: Mother referent is Vega, explicit preceding638 and source668. Restored her; Hokuto wants her explanation.

rows.en: And to do that, we'll beat that bastard Ogre to a pulp...!
rows.notes: Ogre insult and emphatic defeat threat retained. Removed draft addition in Ogre, which unnecessarily specified its pilot.

rows.en: But even if you want to sortie, you don't have a single Data Weapon left...
rows.notes: Intentional source trailing objection; missing Data Weapons predicate restored.

rows.en: Dr. Inoue...
rows.notes: Address fragment summoning Inoue.

rows.en: Um... Well, actually...
rows.notes: Deliberate hesitant opening fragment.

rows.en: What's this...!?
rows.notes: English question restored for source demonstrative fragment.

rows.en: Awesome... A rifle, missiles... There's a whole bunch of other stuff, too!
Are these... weapons for Dendoh!?
Yes. I've been thinking about this ever since you lost the Data Weapons last time.
So, little by little, in secret, I've been working on weapons like missiles, beams, bows, and yo-yos...
rows.notes: Restored Inoue working on listed weapons; trailing list and secret gradual development retained.

rows.en: So this is what you were making, shut away in the factory all that time...
Way to go, Doc! You've really gone up in my book!
rows.notes: Colloquial reassessment praise, not gratitude alone.

rows.en: Really... You must have been preparing for this day for a long time.
Yes... I thought something like this might happen...
Ooh! If a certain someone heard that line, they'd cry their eyes out in frustration!
rows.notes: Unidentified person remains gender-neutral; do not import Uribatake identity.
uncertain: Unidentified envious person could be franchise allusion; no name/gender supplied because source does not settle it.

rows.en: But... Can we really learn to handle all these weapons...?
rows.notes: Ability to master whole arsenal retained.

rows.en: You don't have to worry about that, Hokuto.
Missiles, rifles... We'll teach you tactics for using ranged weapons.
But what about this Go Gun over here?
rows.notes: Source-short Go Gun derived from Dendoh Go Gun glossary weapon; bow context661 resolves reference. Orchestrator confirms source-short naming, supplemental entry.

rows.en: To learn how to use that, please read this.
These are messages from Akira, Ayato, and Rain!
rows.notes: Akira here is Akira Hibiki (Raideen bow user), not Akito; source洸 distinguishes.

rows.en: Heh... Those are instructions from the bow experts. Make sure you read them carefully.
rows.notes: Bow experts are Akira, Ayato, Rain in660; no genders needed.

rows.en: Then what about this yo-yo? Don't tell me someone's sent us a message for that, too...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing speculation, interrupted by no-message answer663.

rows.en: Unfortunately, there's no message for that one...
Don't worry! I practiced like crazy when yo-yos were all the rage a few years ago!
Thank you, Doctor.
You're welcome... They aren't as powerful as the Data Weapons, but I'm sure they'll help you.
Just you wait, Ogre! I'll beat you for sure and make it clear which of us is right!
Yeah...! And we'll get Vega... We'll get Mom back, no matter what...!
rows.notes: Vega-to-Mom self-correction retained.

rows.en: You both look a lot better now.
Heh... It seems your strong spirits have overcome the wounds in your hearts.
It's nothing that great... It's just... All we can do now is fight...!
I'll never give up again... Everyone... Please beat the weakness out of our hearts.
rows.notes: Hokuto asks listeners to toughen their weak hearts, not offer his assistance.

rows.en: Heh heh... You guys will be worth training.
Heh... My training is tough. Don't come crying to me later.
Yeah! Bring it on!!
Good... Once the help Captain Hoshino is bringing arrives, we'll have done everything we can...
rows.notes: Future completion conditional on arriving helper pilots; Captain Hoshino surname preserved.

rows.en: Everyone, prepare to sortie. As soon as we're ready, the Nadesico will head for the enemy battleship!
Yes, sir...!
Yes...!
rows.notes: Context-settled spoken response; no unresolved referent.

rows.en: So this is where that veteran pilot lives... The one that shady old guy found for us.
rows.notes: Shady old guy denotes Prospector; insulting description not softened.

rows.en: That's rude. Apparently, he's an important person in the secretarial department at Nergal Heavy Industries.
rows.notes: Apparently qualifier retained; secretarial department not expanded to business authority.

rows.en: Prospector... So, 'one who sees ahead,' huh...? That's quite an alias...
rows.notes: Source etymological gloss one who sees ahead retained despite ordinary English prospector mining sense.
uncertain: Source gloss of Prospector is etymological/fictional explanation, not usual English dictionary meaning.

rows.en: And that Prospector is going to fetch the other pilot for us, right?
Yes... We don't have much time, so we split into two groups.
By the way, what does the person living here do now?
You'll have to wait and see.
Hello...? Is anyone home...?
rows.notes: Visitor greeting on arrival at occupied home; not apology.

rows.en: Long time no see, Ruri-Ruri!
rows.notes: Ruri-Ruri fixed glossary nickname.

rows.en: You're...
rows.notes: Intentional identity question fragment answered689.

rows.en: I'm Hikaru Amano, artist of hot-blooded boys' manga!!
rows.notes: Hot-blooded boys manga describes genre, not author gender or age; Hikaru glossary full name.

rows.en: Come on in... Pros told me what's going on.
rows.notes: Pros source-short Prospector nickname. Same scene explicitly links Prospector681/682 and694; orchestrator SRW Wiki confirms nickname.

rows.en: Then you'll come with us?
After you've done me a favor...
rows.notes: Hikaru requests help from visitors before agreeing to accompany them; direction preserved.
Silence used three times; one fresh row retained.

rows.en: Are you sure you don't want to say goodbye to the people at the bar...?
rows.notes: Farewell question addressed Izumi; shop is bar clarified695.

rows.en: I was surprised... I never expected you to be running a bar...
rows.notes: Bar mama rendered running bar without inventing bartender ownership.

rows.en: Even more surprising was that your puns had become one of the bar's main attractions...
Well... I trust you and Hikaru won't let that long spell away from piloting bother you.
A long spell... away...
rows.notes: Deliberate deadpan fragment reflecting long gap from697; no invented joke expansion.
uncertain: Possible wordplay beyond literal long blank is not established; deadpan long absence preserved.

rows.en: Gin... Are you going out again?
rows.notes: Gin source-short Ginga nickname; Midori is his mother.

rows.en: Y-yeah...! A junior science trainee has all kinds of things to keep him busy.
rows.notes: Junior science trainee is source cover role, campaign glossary exact spelling.

rows.en: Gin... Come out into the yard for a minute...
Mom...
rows.notes: Intentional address-only fragment.

rows.en: Listen, Gin... Watch this closely...
Haaa...
rows.notes: Breath/focus vocalization, not dialogue content.

rows.en: Hiyaaaaa!!
rows.notes: Martial arts cry prolonged.

rows.en: A-a tree that thick, with just one blow...!
rows.notes: Intentional astonishment fragment; tree and one blow retained, no invented physical action.

rows.en: Gin...
rows.notes: Address fragment.

rows.en: Strength comes from the heart...! ...Don't you forget that...
rows.notes: Source martial arts maxim literally heart-to-strength, no added doctrine. Orchestrator confirms natural literal motto; licensed phrasing remains unverified.
uncertain: Exact licensed English wording of strength/heart maxim unverified.

rows.en: Answer me!
rows.notes: Imperative demand for reply, not an answering response.

rows.en: Yeah!
So you're the members of the Nadesico A's Aestivalis squad...
I've heard about you. I'm counting on you.
rows.notes: Quattro asks arriving pilots support; requester/listener direction made explicit.

rows.en: Wow! The Red Comet and the White Shooting Star together! A red-and-white two-shot! I'm so thrilled!
rows.notes: Red Comet and White Shooting Star bindings preserved; red/white paired-shot enthusiasm retained. Source stray closing wrapper ignored per brief.

rows.en: Two-shot... Make a deposit 'with your passbook'... 'Tsucho to.' Heh heh.
rows.notes: Source pun links two-shot to tsucho to (with a passbook). Deposit/passbook retained with phonetic cue; limited English transfer flagged.
uncertain: Japanese two-shot / tsucho to sound pun cannot rhyme faithfully in English; retained passbook/deposit meaning with romanized source cue.

rows.en: You haven't grown up one bit, have you...?
Oh... Keep that up and I'll take you on again in 'Natural Lychee: Lovey-Dovey Hot-Blooded Operation.'
rows.notes: Quoted fictional title fully rendered; possible exact licensed title absent, reported to root. Root supplemental term retains provisional full subtitle; Magical Princess is not added because absent from source.
uncertain: Complete literal provisional title. Orchestrator found no exact Akurasu entry or independently established licensed English subtitle; only Natural Lychee base spelling externally confirmed.

rows.en: You're on! Don't think it'll go the way it did earlier!
What's... this Natural-whatever thing...?
rows.notes: Natural-whatever deliberately partial title not replaced with full714.

rows.en: It's a fighting game. Hikaru utterly thrashed Ryoko at it.
rows.notes: Ryoko lost badly to Hikaru; direction explicit.

rows.en: Impressive... Your vision for moving objects, reflexes, and feel for the controls are almost unchanged from back then...
rows.notes: All three retained: dynamic vision, reflexes, control feel; nearly not absolutely unchanged.

rows.en: Games are a manga artist's best friend! I've been playing every day!
rows.notes: Daily gaming explains retained skill and sets up missed deadline response720.

rows.en: I think that's why you never meet your deadlines...
rows.notes: Ruri dryly answers Hikaru719 about gaming every day and missing manga deadlines.
Rom's silence; later silence before thanks also checked.
Deliberate silence, not an omitted sentence.

rows.en: So why are the people who went to pick her up so worn out?
rows.notes: Her is Hikaru; exhausted people are Saburota, Hari and Rom who went to collect her.

rows.en: Well... We got roped into lending her a hand with her manga all night...
rows.notes: Roped into/all night preserves being made to act as manga assistants and staying up overnight; English lending a hand sets up725.

rows.en: And right in the middle of the chaos, one day before the deadline...
rows.notes: Deliberate additive fragment continuing723; chaos is the eve-of-deadline production crunch.

rows.en: A hand...? You mean you gave her a lift?
rows.notes: Japanese assistant/legs homophone recast as lending a hand/giving a lift: Drill mistakes artistic assistance for providing transport.
uncertain: The Japanese assistant/legs pun is recast as lending a hand/giving a lift; the comic transport misunderstanding survives but the exact homophone does not.

rows.en: To put it simply... we helped her draw her manga...
rows.notes: Saburota clarifies that they helped draw the manga, answering Drill725.

rows.en: And my brother... He had to model for it, striking all kinds of poses, shouting, and announcing his name.
rows.notes: Leina Stol, not Judau sister Leina; brother is Rom. Model poses, shouts and name announcements retained.

rows.en: But he's perfect as the hero of the hot-blooded boys' manga I draw!
rows.notes: He is Rom; hot-blooded describes the manga hero/style, not the system Hot Blood command.

rows.en: An invincible martial artist who's crazy about his little sister, and even has a catchphrase? He's too good to pass up!!
rows.notes: Rom invincible martial art, intense little-sister affection and catchphrase all retained; crazy about is not a claim of romance.

rows.en: Taking Rom along was the right decision after all.
rows.notes: Rom source-short retained; Ruri affirms bringing him was useful.

rows.en: It certainly was...
rows.notes: Prospector agrees with Ruri730; restored it was.

rows.en: ...You must be exhausted...
rows.notes: Kyoshiro sympathetically addresses the exhausted fetch team, especially Rom after his silence.

rows.en: Everyone... This battle won't just be about rescuing Vega. The fate of the Earth will be at stake...
rows.notes: Shibuya briefing assembled rescuers; both Vega rescue and Earth fate retained.

rows.en: The enemy is immensely powerful... But I believe we will win...!
rows.notes: Shibuya believes the team will win despite enemy strength.

rows.en: I wish you all the best in battle.
rows.notes: Shibuya wishes the team success in combat, not ordering them to pray.

rows.en: Yeah!
Hang on, Vega... We're coming for you now...!
rows.notes: Judau speaks as if addressing captive Vega; team is going to rescue her.

rows.en: Dad...
rows.notes: Hokuto addresses his father Keisuke after prior reused516 at route321.

rows.en: I'm sorry, Hokuto... All I can do is stay here on Earth and pray that you all win...
rows.notes: Keisuke uses father as self-reference; English I. He remains on Earth and prays for team victory.

rows.en: No, Dad... That's more than enough...
rows.notes: Hokuto assures Keisuke his support is enough.

rows.en: I... I'll save Mom, I promise...
rows.notes: Mom is Vega, independently established in glossary character profile; promise of certain rescue retained. Final pause is on the subject, not repeated future verb; preserves hesitation without inventing an actual verb stutter.

rows.en: That's right! Just wait for us, sir!
rows.notes: Ginga addresses Keisuke. Source respectful unrelated older-man address becomes sir, not a literal uncle relationship.

rows.en: Kirakuni... I'm counting on you to look after those two.
rows.notes: Aiko asks Kirakuni to look after Hokuto and Ginga; request direction explicit.

rows.en: Yeah... You can count on me.
rows.notes: Kirakuni offers reassurance to Aiko742; You can count on me is the offering direction.

rows.en: Well then, Ruri... I'll be heading back to the company.
rows.notes: Prospector returns to his employer; company remains unspecified as in source.

rows.en: Thank you for everything, Pros.
rows.notes: Pros is source-short nickname address to Prospector, without full-name expansion.

rows.en: Not at all... If you need anything, just let me know. I wish you victory.
rows.notes: Prospector invites future requests and wishes Ruri/the squad victory.

rows.en: Then we'll set off. Everyone, please take your stations.
rows.notes: Ruri gives departure/station orders to crew.

rows.en: You've grown beautiful, Vega... And you still look just as I remember...
rows.notes: Altair addresses Vega; grown beauty and recognizable former appearance retained.

rows.en: What do you mean, Altair...!?
No... Brother... Are you really...
rows.notes: Vega corrects address from Altair749 to Brother; question deliberately incomplete.

rows.en: For certain reasons, I cannot take this mask off right now...
rows.notes: Altair cites unspecified reasons for being unable to remove mask now; reasons not invented.

rows.en: But I am without a doubt your brother, Altair.
rows.notes: Altair explicitly claims brother identity; independently glossary-backed sibling relationship.

rows.en: It's only natural that you can't believe it right away... I felt the same way...
rows.notes: Altair says he also could not believe Vega survived (resolved by754).

rows.en: Vega... I never imagined you were still alive...
rows.notes: Surprise that Vega is alive, not a claim of prior reunion failure.

rows.en: But...! Then why!? Why would you join Gulfer...!? And when we met again that time, you...
rows.notes: Vega challenges Gulfer affiliation and begins recalling the earlier reunion; last clause deliberately unfinished.

rows.en: My memories had been sealed away... By His Majesty's gracious will, out of concern for me.
rows.notes: Altair treats emperor intervention deferentially and favorably; narration of his claimed memory history, not independent fact.

rows.en: His Majesty...?
rows.notes: Echo fragment asking who His Majesty is.

rows.en: The unbearably painful, sorrowful memories of our planet's final moments...
rows.notes: Deliberate noun-phrase fragment; object of memory sealing, explained759.

rows.en: His Majesty thought I would be better off without memories like those...
rows.notes: His Majesty thought erasing painful memories would benefit Altair; his claim is preserved without endorsing it.

rows.en: But after I met you again, those sealed memories began to return. His Majesty could not bear to see me suffer, so he restored them all...
rows.notes: Altair suffering is triggered by memories reawakening after Vega reunion; emperor restores all sealed memories.

rows.en: Brother...
rows.notes: Brother address-only fragment in two route uses349 and363; both emotional responses fit same English.

rows.en: But I truly would have been happier not knowing...
rows.notes: Altair says he would have been happier unaware, answered by betrayal accusation763-766.

rows.en: You, my only sister, whom they carried off that day...
rows.notes: They are the humans Altair accuses in766/774, not Gulfer; only sister and abduction retained. Sentence continues764-766.

rows.en: My sister, whom I loved so deeply that the feeling lingered despite His Majesty's seal, even if you were deceived...
rows.notes: Altair love persisted somewhere within despite memory sealing; concession that Vega was deceived retained. Continuation of763.

rows.en: ...would take up arms against the Gulfer Emperor, who saved us both and still fights for peace throughout the universe...
rows.notes: Continuation predicate for763-764; taking up arms against emperor, sibling rescue and ongoing universal-peace claim retained.

rows.en: ...by joining those evil humans!
rows.notes: Completes763-765 with joining evil humans; accusation remains Altair perspective.

rows.en: Brother...
rows.notes: Brother address-only fragment; stray post-closing @ indent ignored per brief.

rows.en: His Majesty the Emperor saved you and me the day Alktos was destroyed by the ugly conflicts between humans...
rows.notes: Altair falsely attributes Alktos destruction to human conflicts and sibling rescue to emperor; faithfully translated as his dialogue.

rows.en: Humans are the fearsome destroyers who bring strife throughout this universe...
rows.notes: Humans are subject; fearsome destroyers bringing strife throughout universe restored as full clause.

rows.en: I will strike down humans for His Majesty the Gulfer Emperor, and for peace in the universe...!
rows.notes: Altair vows to strike down humans for emperor and universal peace; violence not softened.

rows.en: Brother! Those memories are false!
rows.notes: Vega contradicts Altair: those are false memories.

rows.en: Wasn't it Gulfer, our planet's ecological management computer, that went out of control, suddenly revolted, and attacked our world!?
rows.notes: Gulfer is ecological management computer of their planet; sudden revolt, going out of control and attacking world all retained.

rows.en: You have been made to believe that, Vega!
rows.notes: Altair says Vega was made to believe her version; agent supplied next row774.

rows.en: By humans who seek to overthrow His Majesty and plunge this entire universe into endless strife!!
rows.notes: Deliberate by-phrase continuation of passive773; humans allegedly want overthrow and endless universal strife.

rows.en: I know this will get us nowhere.
rows.notes: Altair acknowledges discussion stalemate.

rows.en: Even if I tell you the truth now, you won't believe it right away. You were raised to believe otherwise.
rows.notes: Altair says Vega raised with contrary teaching cannot immediately believe his claimed truth.

rows.en: Brother... The truth is...
rows.notes: Vega starts correcting the truth but is interrupted; unfinished predicate preserved.

rows.en: But we don't have much time...
rows.notes: We is Altair/Vega or their shared situation; little time left, not a literal deadline invented.

rows.en: I must capture it, no matter what...
rows.notes: Delayed object it is seventh Data Weapon, identified780; source row boundary retained.

rows.en: The seventh Data Weapon, said to decide the fate of everything... before it falls into their hands...
rows.notes: Names delayed capture object779; all fates and prevention before human capture retained.

rows.en: A seventh...?
rows.notes: Vega echo fragment questioning a seventh.

rows.en: Whoever obtains all the sacred electronic beasts shall become the king of the universe...
rows.notes: Legend register deliberately formal; sacred electronic beast established campaign term; all and kingship retained.

rows.en: You remember this legend handed down on Alktos, don't you...?
rows.notes: Altair expects Vega to remember Alktos inherited legend.

rows.en: The seventh Data Weapon is the final and greatest key...
rows.notes: Seventh Data Weapon final and greatest key both retained.

rows.en: No matter how many Data Weapons you obtain, without it, GEAR can never truly activate...
rows.notes: GEAR frozen acronym kept without expansion or machine-name substitution; true activation rendered true power unleashed. Final restores literal activation predicate rather than interpreting it as power; acronym remains unexpanded.

rows.en: That is why I must never let them have this one, no matter what...
rows.notes: This one is seventh Data Weapon; them is human opposition.

rows.en: But... A seventh...? There should only be six Data Weapons in all...
rows.notes: Vega questions seventh and maintains supposed six-total count.

rows.en: They say the seventh is somewhat different from the other six.
rows.notes: Reportative they say avoids inventing a source; difference from other six retained.

rows.en: And His Majesty said that you should have a clue to it...
rows.notes: His Majesty specifically claims Vega should possess clue to seventh.

rows.en: I do...? Could it be connected to the image Hokuto and the others saw when Kiba was born...
rows.notes: Vega wonders whether clue relates to vision Hokuto and others saw at Kiba birth; interrupted question retained.

rows.en: So you do have a clue to the seventh after all...?
rows.notes: Altair interprets Vega790 as confirmation of clue possession.

rows.en: No... I know nothing of it...
rows.notes: Vega denies knowing clue, not denying existence of seventh as earlier787.

rows.en: Give it to your brother! So that your mistake... does not become something you can never undo...!
rows.notes: Altair demands clue from Vega; brother self-reference retained; preventing irreversible error retained.
Deliberate silence; stray @ after closing ignored per brief.

rows.en: Vega!
rows.notes: Name-only demand in both386 and390; both call to Vega preserved.

rows.en: Even if I knew, I could never give it to you as you are now!
rows.notes: Vega refuses giving clue to her brother in his present manipulated condition, even hypothetically knowing it.

rows.en: What?!
rows.notes: Altair reacts to Leo Circle.

rows.en: You are the one who is wrong... The one being deceived, aren't you, Brother!?
rows.notes: Vega says Altair, not herself, is mistaken/deceived; rhetorical question preserves force.

rows.en: No matter how many times you say it, Brother, those memories of yours are not the truth!
rows.notes: Vega again denies veracity of brother memories no matter how often he insists.

rows.en: Shut up!
rows.notes: Altair forcefully silences Vega; Shut up preserves hostile imperative.

rows.en: You're the one who still doesn't understand!
Enough...! Then I won't ask you anymore!

rows.en: I'll destroy everything that condemned us to this fate!
It seems those humans are attacking again. They never learn.
Once this battle is over, I'll take you to the Gulfer home planet and have His Majesty use his power to correct your memories...
rows.notes: Altair asserts he will correct Vega memories through His Majesty; no endorsement of his false belief.

rows.en: Stay there and watch the humans fall.
Brother... I believe... in the true power that humans possess...
rows.notes: Vega addresses her elder brother; respectful register and human potential retained.

rows.en: Oyakata-sama... The humans appear to be attacking Altair's ship, the Aldebaran.
rows.notes: Oyakata-sama is fixed glossary title. Aldebaran spelling confirmed by root against Akurasu MX Secrets; source identifies Altair ship.

rows.en: This time, they seem to be Dendoh's companions.
I see... Then they won't be as easy to drive off as before...
rows.notes: They is Dendoh allied rescuers; difficulty relative to previous human attacks.

rows.en: Oyakata-sama... I believe this is an opportunity for us as well...
rows.notes: Gourmet sees opportunity for Spiral Castle side.

rows.en: But Altair won't allow us to intervene...
An ally is in danger. Besides, if we handle this well...
rows.notes: Source intentionally trails off on conditional scheme; no invented motive.

rows.en: I see... I'll leave it to you, Gourmet.
rows.notes: Source short Gourmet follows frozen Giga Gourmet label.

rows.en: Yes... I shall meet your expectations, Oyakata-sama, and bury all those who stand in our way at once.
rows.notes: Burial/death threat retained; no softened defeat.

All personnel, launch immediately, please.
You've come to take Vega back, Dendoh...!
Hokuto, Ginga... everyone...!
Intercept them! This time, I'll put an end to everything!
Enemy Machine Beasts have appeared! They're deploying in the space ahead of our ship!
Damn, there are so many of them...!
Mom... She's all the way over there...!!
rows.notes: Explicit she restores mother location predicate; mother identity settled as Vega.

rows.en: Hokuto, you mustn't rush. Keep water's calm within your heart of fire.
rows.notes: Rom mentor counsel keeps fire/water metaphor.

rows.en: Y-yes!
rows.notes: Hokuto responds enthusiastically with a stutter.

rows.en: Ginga, don't forget what your mother taught you.
rows.notes: Kazuya reminds Ginga of Ginga mother teaching, not Hokuto mother.

rows.en: Yeah, strength comes from the heart! I swear I'll rescue Hokuto's mom!
rows.notes: Strength is heart teaching and rescue promise both retained.

rows.en: Without any of its Data Weapons, Dendoh is nothing but a wooden puppet.
rows.notes: Data Weapons plural, all lost, wooden puppet insult retained.

rows.en: Perish right here, along with those fools from #部隊名!
rows.notes: Squad placeholder preserved; target is Dendoh plus allied squad.

rows.notes: Hikaru compares battle chaos to drawing deadlines; deadline hell retains comic extremity.

More importantly, you two... It's been a while since you fought for real. Are you sure you're up to it?
rows.notes: You two is Hikaru and Izumi; Saburota worries about return after combat hiatus.

rows.en: Yeah. Just watch us!
Old Takarazuka skills never fade...

rows.notes: Kyoshiro corrects idiom rather than claiming Takarazuka is a tool.

rows.notes: Deliberate source noun fragment retained; comic riff about commemoration and memories.

rows.notes: Literal loincloth retained because following two rows riff on garment rather than only preparedness idiom.

rows.en: Right, right, they're surprisingly tight.
rows.notes: They refers to loincloths in joke; adjective tight retained.

rows.en: ...Wait, I'm not wearing a loincloth!
rows.notes: I and garment restored; Hikaru corrects joke, not Ryoko order.

rows.notes: Deliberately cut-off Katsuo fu... syllables retained. Root found no independently verified referent; no expansion into a character/product.
uncertain: Cut-off Katsuo f... allusion unresolved; no speculative completion.

rows.notes: Hikaru warns continuing gag risks trouble; nature of restriction not specified.

rows.en: Hey, you idiots! We're about to go rescue Hokuto's mom!!
Get serious, damn it! Serious!!
To Sanzen-in in Search of Mother... That's Ohara, Kyoto...
rows.notes: Literal title-mangling retained: Mother-search anime allusion plus Sanzen-in and Ohara Kyoto. Root verified names with official cultural/travel sources; line is not a canonical English anime title.
uncertain: Japanese Mother-search title/Sanzen-in sound substitution is not directly reproducible; explicit source temple/Ohara Kyoto reference retained.

rows.en: Please make that your last punch line. The enemy's coming, you know?
Oh, right.
...Sorry, Hokuto. We weren't thinking about how you feel...!
rows.notes: Ryoko apology directed at Hokuto, source unfinished remorse retained.

rows.en: No, I understand. You're trying to ease our nerves, aren't you, Hikaru?
rows.notes: Hokuto interprets jokes as relieving nerves; no claim the intent was explicitly confirmed.

rows.en: Hee hee... Maybe I was worrying for nothing?
rows.notes: Hikaru implies nerves were less serious than expected; retrospective worry retained.

rows.en: ...I'll do the job properly.
So let's do our best to rescue your mom!
Yes!
rows.notes: Neutral enthusiastic Yes suitable both encouragement use760 and launch order use901.

rows.en: ...All units. Once we open a breach, we'll go inside... rescue the deputy commander and sink the enemy ship.
rows.notes: Deputy commander is Vega; breach, interior rescue and ship destruction ordered in sequence.

rows.en: Roger!
rows.notes: Kamille acknowledges the order; conventional response retained.

rows.en: All right! Let's go, Hokuto!!
Yeah!

All right! Let's charge straight in!!
Mom, hang on! I'm coming for you now!!
Don't you recognize me, Unicorn?!
rows.notes: Unicorn is source-short Unicorn Drill, not unrelated Gundam unit.
Source silence retained.

rows.notes: Dragon is source-short Dragon Flare; you plural refers to Data Weapons as a group.
Leo Circle remains silent across repeated appearances.

rows.notes: Leo is Leo Circle; Ogre follows Akurasu canonical spelling rather than Oger.

rows.en: Wake up, Boar! Do you know what you're doing?!
rows.notes: Boar is source-short Gatling Boar; rhetorical awakening command preserved.

rows.en: My mom... Give me back my mom!!
So you've learned that Vega is your mother, Dendoh pilot! But everything you've been taught is a lie!
rows.notes: Altair addresses Hokuto about his own mother, then both pilots about false teachings.

rows.en: As long as Dendoh exists, there will never be an end to war in this universe!
Shut up! You're the one who's wrong!
I believe in my mom! I'll protect her!!
Protect... Vega...?! Ghh! Ugh!!
rows.notes: Deliberate echo fragment from Hokuto pledge; physical pain cries retained.
Wordless startled reaction retained.

rows.en: V-Vega...!!
I'm protecting Vega... Don't worry, Altair...
rows.notes: Unknown thought speaker label remains ???. All three uses checked at268,422,433; speaker promises present protection of Vega, addresses Altair; identity not inserted.

rows.en: Uuugh!!
H-he's in pain...?!
rows.notes: He is Altair, observed in pain; grounded by865-868.

rows.en: I don't know what's going on, but this is our chance! Let's take Ogre down in one go!!
Ghh! I won't let you, Dendoh!!
Death is all that awaits those who lend Dendoh their strength...!
Strange... This man's presence is weaker than usual...!
rows.notes: Amuro senses Altair diminished presence through Newtype intuition; not ordinary physical strength.

rows.en: Ghh...! Neither I... nor Gulfer will ever know defeat!!
rows.notes: Altair denies defeat for both himself and Gulfer; neither/nor restores both grammatical subjects without losing jagged pauses.

rows.en: This feeling... Could it be...?! Is this man... under mind control...?!
rows.notes: Kamille infers mind control tentatively; not a confirmed report.

rows.en: Ugh... Ghh...! What's with... this headache...?!
What...?! Is he... torn over something...?!
rows.notes: Judau senses Altair inner hesitation; not literal lost navigation.

rows.en: Ghh... Vega... My sister...
rows.notes: Deliberate recognition fragment; my sister is Vega.

rows.en: His sister...?!
rows.notes: Quattro echoes Altair sister disclosure; possessive restored from context.

rows.notes: Battle exchange: allies challenge Altair, whose pain suggests buried identity, and Rom targets his mask. Question about Altair's hidden identity/memories, not a literal object inventory.

rows.en: What's wrong, Ogre!? Is that all the power you have!?
rows.notes: Battle exchange: allies challenge Altair, whose pain suggests buried identity, and Rom targets his mask. Source interjection retained; complete propositions restore scene-established subject/verb.

rows.notes: Battle exchange: allies challenge Altair, whose pain suggests buried identity, and Rom targets his mask. Headache and interrupted self-identification retained.

rows.notes: Battle exchange: allies challenge Altair, whose pain suggests buried identity, and Rom targets his mask. Echo question; restored Something rather than silently specifying memories.

rows.notes: Giga Gourmet arrives as apparent aid, attacks Altair's ship and flees; allies react to the betrayal. Unknown new type among Machine Beasts is not a Machine Knight; no assumed species/gender.

rows.notes: Giga Gourmet arrives as apparent aid, attacks Altair's ship and flees; allies react to the betrayal. Giga Gourmet feigns assistance to Altair.

rows.notes: Giga Gourmet arrives as apparent aid, attacks Altair's ship and flees; allies react to the betrayal. Oyakata-sama is glossary fixed title; retain rather than translating as my lord.

rows.notes: Giga Gourmet arrives as apparent aid, attacks Altair's ship and flees; allies react to the betrayal. Spiral Castle is used metonymically as apparent sender; do not replace with an invented ruler name.

rows.notes: Giga Gourmet arrives as apparent aid, attacks Altair's ship and flees; allies react to the betrayal. Source interjection retained; complete propositions restore scene-established subject/verb.

rows.notes: Giga Gourmet arrives as apparent aid, attacks Altair's ship and flees; allies react to the betrayal. Witness final deaths of the two robots; restored predicate; sinister meaning retained.
